title: Goldreich–Levin Query State
statement: For a natural number $n$, a Goldreich–Levin query state consists of an optional finite family of subsets of $[n]$ and a finite list of estimate records for $n$ coordinates. The optional family is the active family, and each record contains a coordinate set, a frequency prefix, and a rational estimate.
